identity.title: Move Shell Recipe dialog I/O to a concrete UI adapter

origin.kind: user continuation request and Shell View boundary audit
origin.summary: The user asked to continue Shell View refactoring. The remaining dialog/file-picker/external-evidence methods form one UI side-effect boundary with test hooks and can leave the composition View without changing Recipe contracts.

state.current_summary: PL-0016 is verified: Recipe dialog, file-picker, and qualified-evidence side effects now have one concrete adapter owner; Shell and Recipe callback/test contracts are preserved; focused builds and contracts pass; runtime UI interaction remains unverified.

objective.summary: Move Shell Recipe dialog/file-picker/external-evidence UI side effects from OpenVisionShellHostView into one concrete RecipeDialogAdapter while preserving all callback signatures, test override properties, language text, modal owner resolution, and failure behavior.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev and preserve the existing dirty worktree.
Do not add an interface, factory, manager, or partial.
Keep RecipeCommandSurface callback signatures and public/internal *ForTest names unchanged.
Keep Window owner resolution, dialog options, language text, Process.Start behavior, exception handling, and return values unchanged.
Do not move Recipe persistence or workflow policy; the adapter owns only WPF dialog/process side effects.
Skip hardware and full runtime UI validation; record it as unverified.

criteria.text: RecipeDialogAdapter owns the existing Shell Recipe MessageBox, file/folder picker, and qualified-evidence open methods; OpenVisionShellHostView no longer contains their implementations.
RecipeCommandSurface callback signatures, XAML/public bindings, and QualifiedSnapshot*ForTest properties remain unchanged and route through the adapter.
Sequential Debug/Release solution and focused smoke/readiness/refactor/documentation checks pass with no new warnings or errors attributable to this slice.
Completion evidence records current/intended owner, call path, mutable state and lifetime owner, junior readability result, and runtime UI boundaries.

evidence.observation: RecipeDialogAdapter is the concrete owner of Recipe/Pipeline/Validation Set confirmation, file/folder picker, and qualified evidence open operations. OpenVisionShellHostView constructs it and passes method groups to RecipeCommandSurface; View no longer contains those direct dialog/process implementations. The existing TestSurface forwards QualifiedSnapshot test delegates to the adapter.

PL0016_DIALOG_ADAPTER_CONTRACT=PASS. The normalized moved dialog body has identical before/after SHA-256 efa1744ffc4b6a9fccf3782cf0b17de51b65d365da0695ee0332b2be55d4e294 and length 6777; direct View dialog I/O is absent; callbacks and test hooks route through the adapter.
Sequential OpenVisionLab solution and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug/Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors after the final adapter and formatting edits.
ShellRecipeBasicLifecycleViewContract passed 7/7 in Debug and Release; OpenVisionReadinessCheck passed in Debug and Release.

RefactorAudit passed with CSharpFiles=816, XamlFiles=60, PartialDeclarations=59, PartialTextMatches=2, ProjectCycles=0, ShellStorageCalls=0. DocumentationIndex passed with IndexedPaths=288, Routes=16, RootRedirects=102. git diff --check returned exit code 0 with only existing line-ending conversion warnings.

Independent junior-readability review accepts the concrete adapter as a real navigation and ownership improvement. It records the residual pending-edit dialog as a separate existing contract and marks actual dialog interaction, external folder launch, localization rendering, WPF runtime matrix, hardware, and long-run shutdown as unverified.

events.summary: All PL-0016 criteria are evidenced. The Shell View no longer owns the Recipe dialog/file-picker/process side effects, callback and test contracts remain compatible, focused verification passes, and unverified runtime boundaries are explicitly recorded.
